Class ValidationResultImpl

java.lang.Object
iu.validation.ValidationResultImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
IuValidationResult, Iterable<IuConstraintViolation>
final class ValidationResultImpl extends Object implements IuValidationResult
Every violation from one validation pass, sorted, deduplicated, and renderable as a log record.

    • report

      public String report(boolean includeValues)
      Description copied from interface: IuValidationResult
      Renders every violation as a multi-line report suitable for a log record.
      Specified by:
      report in interface IuValidationResult
      Parameters:
      includeValues - true to append each invalid value to its line; false to redact. Validated input is frequently sensitive, so pass true only for a destination that is cleared to receive it.
      Returns:
      multi-line report; a single line stating validity when IuValidationResult.isValid()
